title: C1 dan C2 ga: ona tiliga yaqinlashish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida C2 darajasi nimani anglatishini tushuntira olasiz, o‘zingizdagi qolgan bo‘shliqlarni (aniqlik, artikl, ibora fe’llar, ohang) aniqlaysiz, to‘rtta immersiya usulini bilasiz va o‘lchanadigan maqsadlar bilan shaxsiy C2 rejangizni tuzasiz.

scenes.title: C2 darajasiga xush kelibsiz
board: (C1 dan C2 ga: ona tiliga yaqinlashish)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum va C2 darajasiga xush kelibsiz! Oldingi darsda C1 darajasini to‘liq takrorlab, yakuniy imtihon topshirdingiz. Bugun yangi bosqich boshlanadi. Dars oxirida C2 aslida nimani anglatishini bilasiz, o‘zingizdagi qolgan bo‘shliqlarni topasiz, immersiya usullarini o‘rganasiz va shaxsiy rejangizni tuzasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to C2. At this level, the question is no longer whether you can say something, but whether you can say exactly what you mean, with ease.
scenes.say_uz: C2 ga xush kelibsiz. Bu darajada savol endi biror narsani ayta olasizmi emas, balki aynan nimani nazarda tutayotganingizni bemalol ayta olasizmi, shunda.

scenes.title: C2 nima?
board: Understands with ease virtually everything heard or read
Expresses himself/herself spontaneously, very fluently and precisely
scenes.say_native: Yevropa umumiy til ko‘rsatkichlari, ya’ni CEFR, C2 ni shunday tasvirlaydi: deyarli hamma eshitgan va o‘qiganini oson tushunadi, o‘z fikrini o‘z-o‘zidan, ravon va aniq ifodalaydi, murakkab vaziyatlarda ham ma’noning nozik farqlarini ajratadi. Kalit so‘zlar ikkita: “oson” va “nozik”. C1 da siz ko‘p narsani qila olasiz, C2 da esa buni kuch sarflamay va aniq qilasiz.
scenes.say: The CEFR describes C2 users as people who understand virtually everything with ease and who can differentiate finer shades of meaning. Effortless precision: that's the heart of it.
scenes.say_uz: CEFR C2 egalarini deyarli hamma narsani oson tushunadigan va ma’noning nozik farqlarini ajrata oladigan odamlar deb ta’riflaydi. Kuch sarflamasdan aniqlik: mohiyati shu.

scenes.title: C2 ona tili egasi degani emas
board: An accent is fine; misunderstanding is not
scenes.say_native: Muhim nuqta: CEFR mualliflari C2 ni ona tili egasining darajasi deb hisoblamaydi. Demak, maqsad aksentdan butunlay qutulish yoki o‘zingizni amerikalik qilib ko‘rsatish emas. Maqsad aniq, tabiiy va moslashuvchan gapirish, tinglovchi sizni bir marta eshitib tushunishi. Ko‘plab taniqli olimlar, yozuvchilar va diplomatlar aksent bilan gapiradi, lekin ularning ingliz tili mukammal.
scenes.say: C2 is not the same as being a native speaker. Plenty of brilliant writers and diplomats have an accent. What they don't have is any difficulty making themselves understood exactly.
scenes.say_uz: C2 ona tili egasi bo‘lish bilan bir xil emas. Ko‘plab ajoyib yozuvchi va diplomatlarning aksenti bor. Lekin ular fikrini aniq tushuntirishda hech qiynalmaydi.

scenes.title: Birinchi belgi: aniqlik
board: a small rise → a marginal rise

examples.uz: U taklifni muloyimlik bilan rad etdi.

examples.t: The bridge is notorious for traffic jams.
examples.uz: Bu ko‘prik tirbandliklari bilan yomon nom chiqargan.

scenes.say_native: C2 dagi aniqlik umumiy so‘z o‘rniga aynan vaziyatga mos so‘zni tanlash demak. “Refuse” va “decline” ikkalasi ham rad etish, lekin taklifni odatda muloyimlik bilan “decline” qilasiz. “Famous” yaxshi nom bilan, “notorious” esa yomon nom bilan mashhur. O‘zbek tilida biz ham “mashhur” va “dong‘i ketgan” ni farqlaymiz. Inglizchada bunday juftlar juda ko‘p.
scenes.say: Precision means choosing the word that fits the situation exactly. You decline an invitation rather than refuse it, and a place known for something bad is notorious, not famous.
scenes.say_uz: Aniqlik vaziyatga aynan mos so‘zni tanlash demak. Taklifni refuse emas, decline qilasiz, yomon narsa bilan tanilgan joy esa famous emas, notorious.

scenes.title: Konnotatsiya: bir ma’no, uch baho

examples.t: He's too stingy to buy anyone a coffee.
examples.uz: U shunchalik xasiski, hech kimga qahva ham olib bermaydi. (salbiy)

scenes.say_native: Nozik ma’no ko‘pincha konnotatsiyada, ya’ni so‘zning ijobiy yoki salbiy bo‘yog‘ida yashiringan. Pulni ehtiyot qiladigan odam “frugal” bo‘lsa maqtov, “stingy” bo‘lsa tanqid. Britaniyada “mean” ham xasis ma’nosini beradi. Ozg‘in odam “slim” bo‘lsa yoqimli, “skinny” bo‘lsa ko‘pincha salbiy. O‘zbekchadagi “tejamkor” va “xasis” farqi bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: Frugal and stingy describe the same behaviour, but one is a compliment and the other is an insult. At C2, you choose the word that carries the attitude you intend.
scenes.say_uz: Frugal va stingy bir xil xatti-harakatni tasvirlaydi, lekin biri maqtov, ikkinchisi haqorat. C2 da siz o‘zingiz nazarda tutgan munosabatni tashiydigan so‘zni tanlaysiz.

scenes.title: Aniqlikdagi xatolar
board: ✗ a big amount of money  ✓ a large amount of money
✗ He's a famous criminal.  ✓ He's a notorious criminal.
✗ She said me the truth.  ✓ She told me the truth.
scenes.say_native: C1 da tushunarli bo‘lgan xatolar C2 da ko‘zga tashlanadi. “Big amount” emas, “large amount”, chunki “amount” va “number” bilan “large” ishlatiladi. Jinoyatchi “famous” emas, “notorious”. “Say” va “tell” ni ham chalkashtirmang: “tell me”, lekin “say to me”. Bu xatolar ma’noni buzmaydi, lekin tinglovchiga sizning ona tilingiz ingliz tili emasligini darhol bildiradi.
scenes.say: These slips don't block communication, but they mark you out as a learner. A large amount, not a big amount. A notorious criminal. She told me, not she said me.
scenes.say_uz: Bu xatolar muloqotga to‘sqinlik qilmaydi, lekin sizni o‘rganuvchi sifatida ajratib ko‘rsatadi. Big amount emas, large amount. Notorious criminal. She said me emas, she told me.

scenes.title: Mashq: aniq so‘zni tanlang
board: 2) She politely ___ the job offer. (refused / declined)
3) Not perfect, but the results were ___ . (good / encouraging)
4) He never buys anyone a coffee; he's so ___ . (frugal / stingy)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap, har birida ikkita variant. Ikkalasi ham grammatik to‘g‘ri bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin bittasi aniqroq va vaziyatga mosroq. Uchinchisida “mukammal emas, lekin umid beradigan” degan ma’noni, to‘rtinchisida esa gapiruvchining salbiy munosabatini e’tiborga oling. O‘n besh soniya.
scenes.say: Choose the more precise word in each sentence. Fifteen seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapda aniqroq so‘zni tanlang. O‘n besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: aniqlik
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “notorious”, chunki jinoyat yomon narsa. Ikkinchi: “declined”, ish taklifini muloyimlik bilan rad etish uchun eng tabiiy fe’l. Uchinchi: “encouraging”, ya’ni umid uyg‘otadigan, bu “good” dan ancha aniq. To‘rtinchi: “stingy”, chunki gap ohangi tanqidiy. “Frugal” bu yerda maqtovga aylanib, ma’noni buzadi.
scenes.say: Notorious, declined, encouraging and stingy. In each case, the second word carries exactly the meaning and attitude the sentence needs.
scenes.say_uz: Notorious, declined, encouraging va stingy. Har birida ikkinchi so‘z gapga kerakli ma’no va munosabatni aynan beradi.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi belgi: munosabat bildiruvchi ravishlar

examples.t: Admittedly, the plan is expensive, but it works.
examples.uz: Tan olish kerak, reja qimmat, lekin u ishlaydi.

examples.t: Supposedly, the new system saves time.

scenes.say_native: C2 egasi munosabatini bitta ravish bilan bildiradi. “Admittedly” — qarshi fikrni tan olaman, “supposedly” — shunday deyishadi, lekin men shubhadaman, “frankly” — ochiq, ko‘pincha tanqidiy gap, “understandably” — hamdardlik. O‘zbekchada ham “go‘yoki”, “ochig‘ini aytsam” deymiz. Farqi shuki, inglizchada bu ravishlar gap boshida vergul bilan ajratiladi va ohang orqali ham ta’kidlanadi.
scenes.say: A single stance adverb at the start of a sentence can tell the listener exactly where you stand. Supposedly signals doubt. Admittedly concedes a point. Frankly prepares them for blunt honesty.
scenes.say_uz: Gap boshidagi bitta munosabat ravishi tinglovchiga qayerda turganingizni aniq bildiradi. Supposedly shubhani bildiradi. Admittedly fikrni tan oladi. Frankly ochiq gapga tayyorlaydi.

scenes.title: Mashq: gapiruvchi nimani his qilyapti?
board: 1) Supposedly, the new manager is an expert.
2) Admittedly, I should have checked the figures.
3) Frankly, the presentation was a mess.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni o‘qing va har birida gapiruvchining munosabatini bir-ikki so‘z bilan ayting: shubha, tan olish, ochiq tanqid yoki hamdardlik. Faqat ravishga qarab aniqlang, gapning qolgan qismi deyarli neytral. Javobni o‘zbekcha yozsangiz ham bo‘ladi. O‘n ikki soniya.
scenes.say: What is the speaker's attitude in each sentence? Twelve seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapda gapiruvchining munosabati qanday? O‘n ikki soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: munosabat
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: shubha, gapiruvchi menejer haqiqatan mutaxassis ekaniga ishonmaydi. Ikkinchi: o‘z xatosini tan olish. Uchinchi: ochiq, keskin tanqid. To‘rtinchi: hamdardlik, xodimlarning xavotiri tabiiy deb hisoblanadi. Ko‘rdingizmi, bitta so‘z butun gapning ohangini belgilaydi. Mana shu C2 dagi nuans.
scenes.say: Doubt, a concession, blunt criticism and sympathy. One word, and the whole sentence changes colour.
scenes.say_uz: Shubha, tan olish, keskin tanqid va hamdardlik. Bitta so‘z va butun gapning bo‘yog‘i o‘zgaradi.

scenes.title: Qolgan bo‘shliqlar xaritasi
scenes.say_native: Ko‘pchilik C1 egalari o‘xshash joyda to‘xtab qoladi. Ingliz tilida buni “plateau” deyishadi: o‘sish sekinlashadi, chunki asosiy narsalar bor, qolganlari esa mayda tuyuladi. To‘rtta bo‘shliq ko‘p uchraydi: artikllar, ibora fe’llar va tabiiy birikmalar, ona tilidan ko‘chgan qotgan xatolar va nutq ohangi. Endi ularni birma-bir ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: Most C1 users hit a plateau. They understand nearly everything, yet they still sound a little textbook. The gaps are usually the same four.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘pchilik C1 egalari to‘xtab qoladi. Ular deyarli hamma narsani tushunadi, lekin gapi hali ham biroz darslikka o‘xshaydi. Bo‘shliqlar odatda o‘sha to‘rttasi.

scenes.title: Birinchi bo‘shliq: artikllar
board: go to bed / to school / to prison (purpose) — no article
Life is short. · The life of a soldier is hard.

examples.t: She's been in hospital since Monday.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek va rus tillarida artikl yo‘q, shuning uchun artikl C2 da ham eng uzoq saqlanadigan bo‘shliq. Nozik qoidalar: muassasaga asosiy maqsadida borsangiz, artikl qo‘yilmaydi: “go to bed”, “go to prison”. Britaniyada “in hospital”, Amerikada “in the hospital”. Mavhum ot umumiy ma’noda artiklsiz: “Life is short”, lekin aniqlansa: “the life of a soldier”.
scenes.say: Articles are the last frontier for speakers of languages without them. Life is short, but the life of a soldier is hard. In British English, you're in hospital; in American English, in the hospital.
scenes.say_uz: Artikli yo‘q tillar egalari uchun artikllar so‘nggi chegara. Hayot qisqa, lekin askar hayoti og‘ir. Britaniyada in hospital, Amerikada in the hospital deyiladi.

scenes.title: Artikl xatolari
board: ✗ The life is beautiful.  ✓ Life is beautiful.
✗ I went to the bed early.  ✓ I went to bed early.
✗ I'm going to the university tomorrow. (as a student)  ✓ I'm going to university.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi ikkita xato rus tili ta’sirida ham, haddan ortiq tuzatishdan ham kelib chiqadi: o‘quvchi “artikl kerak” deb hamma joyga “the” qo‘yadi. “The life is beautiful” emas, “Life is beautiful”. “Go to the bed” deyilsa, ma’lum bir karavotga borayapsiz degan ma’no chiqadi, uxlashga emas. C2 dagi qoida: artiklni har safar ma’noga qarab tanlang, odatga qarab emas.
scenes.say: Don't overcorrect by adding the everywhere. Life is beautiful, with no article, because you mean life in general. And you go to bed to sleep, not to the bed.
scenes.say_uz: Hamma joyga the qo‘shib, ortiqcha tuzatmang. Life is beautiful artiklsiz, chunki umuman hayotni nazarda tutasiz. Uxlash uchun to bed deyiladi, to the bed emas.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi bo‘shliq: ibora fe’llar
board: postpone → put off · tolerate → put up with

examples.t: We had to put the meeting off until Friday.
It turned out that she'd known all along.
examples.uz: Ma’lum bo‘lishicha, u boshidan bilgan ekan.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek va rus tilida so‘zlashuvchilar rasmiy, lotincha so‘zlarni yaxshi o‘rganadi: “postpone”, “tolerate”, “discover”. Lekin ona tili egalari kundalik nutqda ko‘proq ibora fe’l ishlatadi: “put off”, “put up with”, “find out”. Agar siz doim rasmiy fe’l ishlatsangiz, nutqingiz to‘g‘ri, lekin qog‘ozdan o‘qilayotgandek eshitiladi. C2 da ikkala qatlamni ham erkin ishlatish kerak.
scenes.say: In everyday speech, native speakers reach for phrasal verbs. They put things off, put up with noise and come up with ideas. Use only the formal verbs, and you'll sound like a written report.
scenes.say_uz: Kundalik nutqda ona tili egalari ibora fe’llarni tanlaydi. Ishni put off qiladi, shovqinga put up with qiladi, g‘oya come up with qiladi. Faqat rasmiy fe’llarni ishlatsangiz, yozma hisobotga o‘xshab qolasiz.

scenes.title: Bitta fe’l, ko‘p ma’no: pick up
board: pick up a phone · pick someone up at 7
pick up a language · pick up on a hint

examples.t: She picked up Italian while living in Rome.
examples.uz: U Rimda yashab, italyanchani o‘z-o‘zidan o‘rganib oldi.

examples.t: He didn't pick up on the hint.
Sales picked up in the spring.

scenes.say_native: C2 da ibora fe’lning bitta ma’nosini bilish yetmaydi. “Pick up” telefonni ko‘tarish, odamni mashinada olib ketish, tilni o‘z-o‘zidan o‘rganib olish, ishorani payqash va savdoning jonlanishi bo‘lishi mumkin. Lug‘atda bunday fe’llarning barcha ma’nolarini ko‘rib, har biriga o‘zingiz misol yozing. Kontekst ma’noni deyarli har doim aniq ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: She picked up Italian while living in Rome. He didn't pick up on the hint. Sales picked up in the spring. Same verb, three quite different meanings.
scenes.say_uz: U Rimda yashab, italyanchani o‘rganib oldi. U ishorani payqamadi. Bahorda savdo jonlandi. Bitta fe’l, uchta butunlay boshqa ma’no.

scenes.title: Mashq: ibora fe’l bilan almashtiring
board: 1) We had to postpone the meeting.
3) The rumour proved to be true.
4) I can't tolerate this noise any longer.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapdagi rasmiy fe’lni ibora fe’l bilan almashtiring, shunda gap tabiiy og‘zaki nutqqa aylanadi. Zamonni saqlashni unutmang: birinchi va ikkinchi gaplar o‘tgan zamonda. Uchinchisida “it” bilan boshlanadigan qolipni ham ishlatib ko‘rishingiz mumkin. O‘n besh soniya.
scenes.say: Replace each formal verb with a phrasal verb. Keep the tense. Fifteen seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir rasmiy fe’lni ibora fe’l bilan almashtiring. Zamonni saqlang. O‘n besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: ibora fe’llar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “We had to put off the meeting” yoki “put the meeting off”. Bu fe’l ajraladi, to‘ldiruvchi o‘rtada ham kelishi mumkin. Ikkinchi: “She came up with a brilliant excuse”. Uchinchi: “The rumour turned out to be true” yoki “It turned out that the rumour was true”. To‘rtinchi: “I can’t put up with this noise any longer”, bu uch qismli fe’l ajralmaydi.
scenes.say: We had to put the meeting off. She came up with a brilliant excuse. The rumour turned out to be true. I can't put up with this noise any longer.
scenes.say_uz: Yig‘ilishni qoldirishga majbur bo‘ldik. U ajoyib bahona o‘ylab topdi. Mish-mish rost bo‘lib chiqdi. Bu shovqinga endi chiday olmayman.

scenes.title: Uchinchi bo‘shliq: qotgan xatolar
board: ✗ open / close the TV  ✓ turn on / turn off the TV
✗ according to me  ✓ in my view
✗ make a photo  ✓ take a photo
✗ not enough good  ✓ not good enough
scenes.say_native: Qotgan xatolar ko‘pincha ona tilidan so‘zma-so‘z ko‘chadi. O‘zbekchada “televizorni och” deymiz, shuning uchun “open the TV” chiqadi, to‘g‘risi “turn on”. Ruschadan esa “сделать фото” orqali “make a photo” keladi, to‘g‘risi “take a photo”. “According to me” o‘rniga “in my view”, “not enough good” o‘rniga “not good enough”, chunki “enough” sifatdan keyin keladi.
scenes.say: Fossilised errors are usually translations from your first language. You turn on the TV, take a photo, give your view rather than say according to me, and something is good enough, not enough good.
scenes.say_uz: Qotgan xatolar odatda ona tilidan tarjimadir. Televizorni turn on qilasiz, rasmga take a photo deysiz, according to me o‘rniga in my view, not enough good emas, good enough.

scenes.title: To‘rtinchi bo‘shliq: ohang va ritm
board: Falling tone: That's an interesting idea. ↘ (genuine)
scenes.say_native: C2 dagi nuans faqat so‘zda emas, ohangda ham. “That’s an interesting idea” pasayuvchi ohangda aytilsa, chin maqtov. Pasayib-ko‘tariluvchi ohangda aytilsa, “lekin…” degan yashirin shubha bor. O‘zbek tilida biz ham ohang bilan kinoya qilamiz, lekin inglizcha ohang shakli boshqacha. Kuchsiz shakllarni ham unutmang: “for”, “to”, “can” urg‘usiz holatda qisqarib aytiladi.
scenes.say: Intonation carries meaning. Said with a fall, that's an interesting idea is a compliment. Said with a fall-rise, it often means: but I have my doubts.
scenes.say_uz: Ohang ma’no tashiydi. Pasayuvchi ohangda that’s an interesting idea maqtov. Pasayib-ko‘tariluvchi ohangda esa ko‘pincha “lekin menda shubha bor” degani.

scenes.title: Mashq: ikki ohangda ayting
scenes.say_native: Ikkala gapni ikki xil ohangda ovoz chiqarib ayting: avval pasayuvchi, keyin pasayib-ko‘tariluvchi. Har safar o‘zingizdan so‘rang: tinglovchi bu yerda nimani tushunadi, maqtovnimi yoki shubhanimi? Ikkinchi gapda “suppose” so‘zining o‘zi qanday ohangni yoqtirishini ham o‘ylang. O‘n besh soniya.
scenes.say: Say each sentence twice, first with a fall, then with a fall-rise. What does the listener hear each time? Fifteen seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni ikki marta ayting: avval pasayuvchi, keyin pasayib-ko‘tariluvchi ohangda. Tinglovchi har safar nimani eshitadi? O‘n besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javob: ohang
board: 'I suppose it could work…' ↘↗ = reluctant agreement
scenes.say_native: Pasayuvchi ohang gapni tugallangan va samimiy qiladi. Pasayib-ko‘tariluvchi ohang esa gapni ochiq qoldiradi: tinglovchi “lekin” ni kutadi. “I suppose it could work” ning o‘zi ham ikkilanish bildiradi, pasayib-ko‘tariluvchi ohang bilan esa u deyarli istamay rozi bo‘lish bo‘lib eshitiladi. Bunday nozikliklarni eshitish va ishlata olish C2 belgisi.
scenes.say: A fall sounds complete and sincere. A fall-rise leaves the door open for a but. With a fall-rise, I suppose it could work sounds like reluctant agreement.
scenes.say_uz: Pasayuvchi ohang tugal va samimiy. Pasayib-ko‘tariluvchi ohang lekin uchun eshikni ochiq qoldiradi. Shu ohangda I suppose it could work istamay rozi bo‘lishdek eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Birinchi tinglash: plato haqida
board: Aziz and Sara talk about the C1 plateau
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Aziz bir yildan beri bir joyda turibdi, uning tanishi Sara esa sababini topadi. Azizning har kuni nima qilayotgani va Sara qanday maslahat berayotganiga e’tibor bering. “Textbook” bu yerda sifat sifatida, ya’ni darslikdagidek, sun’iy degan ma’noda ishlatilgan.
scenes.say: Aziz: I've been stuck at the same level for a year. I understand almost everything, but I still sound so textbook. Sara: That's the classic plateau. What are you actually doing every day? Aziz: Mostly watching series, with subtitles. Sara: English subtitles? Aziz: Uzbek, if I'm honest. Sara: Well, there's your problem. You're entertaining yourself, not training. Switch to English subtitles, and start noting down whole phrases, not single words.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz: Bir yildan beri bir darajada qotib qoldim. Deyarli hammasini tushunaman, lekin gapim hali ham darslikdagidek. Sara: Bu klassik plato. Har kuni aslida nima qilyapsan? Aziz: Asosan subtitr bilan serial ko‘raman. Sara: Inglizcha subtitrmi? Aziz: Rostini aytsam, o‘zbekcha. Sara: Mana muammo. Sen mashq qilmayapsan, ko‘ngil ochyapsan. Inglizcha subtitrga o‘t va alohida so‘zlarni emas, butun iboralarni yozib bor.

scenes.title: Birinchi tinglash savollari
board: 3) What two pieces of advice does she give?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Azizning muammosi nimada, u nimani qila oladi va nimani qila olmaydi. Ikkinchi: Sara uning qaysi odatini tanqid qiladi. Uchinchi: Sara qanday ikki maslahat beradi. Javoblarni qisqa yozing. Sara aytgan iboralarni eslashga harakat qiling. O‘n ikki soniya.
scenes.say: Three questions about Aziz and Sara. Twelve seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz va Sara haqida uchta savol. O‘n ikki soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: birinchi tinglash
board: 1) He understands almost everything but sounds unnatural
2) Watching with Uzbek subtitles: entertainment, not training
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: Aziz deyarli hammasini tushunadi, lekin nutqi sun’iy, darslikdagidek. Ikkinchi: Sara uning serialni o‘zbekcha subtitr bilan ko‘rishini tanqid qiladi, bu mashq emas, ko‘ngilochar. Uchinchi: inglizcha subtitrga o‘tish va alohida so‘zlarni emas, butun iboralarni yozib borish. “Entertaining yourself, not training” iborasi bu darsning asosiy g‘oyalaridan biri.
scenes.say: Aziz understands almost everything but sounds unnatural. Sara criticises the Uzbek subtitles. Her advice: switch to English subtitles and collect whole phrases.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz deyarli hammasini tushunadi, lekin tabiiy gapirmaydi. Sara o‘zbekcha subtitrni tanqid qiladi. Maslahati: inglizcha subtitrga o‘tish va butun iboralarni yig‘ish.

scenes.title: Immersiya 1: ko‘p va xilma-xil kirish
scenes.say_native: Birinchi immersiya usuli: ko‘p va xilma-xil material. C2 uchun moslashtirilgan matnlar endi yetmaydi, haqiqiy romanlar, uzun jurnalistik maqolalar, ma’ruza va podkastlar kerak. Turli aksentlarni ham tinglang: Britaniya, Amerika, Avstraliya, Hindiston, Shotlandiya. O‘zbekistonda yashab ham immersiya qilish mumkin: muhit sizning telefoningiz va qulog‘ingizdagi narsadan boshlanadi.
scenes.say: Immersion doesn't require moving abroad. It starts with what's on your phone and in your ears: novels, long-form articles, lectures and podcasts, in as many accents as possible.
scenes.say_uz: Immersiya chet elga ko‘chishni talab qilmaydi. U telefoningiz va qulog‘ingizdagi narsadan boshlanadi: romanlar, uzun maqolalar, ma’ruzalar va podkastlar, iloji boricha ko‘p aksentlarda.

scenes.title: Immersiya 2: payqash va iboralar daftari
board: ✓ Smartphones have become ubiquitous in classrooms.

examples.t: to bear the brunt of something
examples.uz: biror narsaning eng og‘ir zarbasini ko‘tarmoq

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi usul: payqash. O‘qiyotganda yoki tinglayotganda sizni hayratga solgan iborani to‘xtab belgilang, keyin daftarga butun kontekst bilan yozing. Yakka so‘z emas, butun gap: “Smartphones have become ubiquitous in classrooms”. So‘ng bir hafta ichida o‘sha iborani o‘zingiz ikki marta ishlating. Payqamagan narsangiz o‘zlashmaydi.
scenes.say: Notice, collect, reuse. When a phrase strikes you, write down the whole sentence it came in, not just the word. Then use it yourself twice within a week.
scenes.say_uz: Payqang, yig‘ing, qayta ishlating. Biror ibora e’tiboringizni tortsa, faqat so‘zni emas, u kelgan butun gapni yozib oling. So‘ng bir hafta ichida uni o‘zingiz ikki marta ishlating.

scenes.title: Immersiya 3: soya usuli
board: Shadowing: listen → repeat a split second behind
10 minutes a day · record once a week
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi usul: shadowing, ya’ni soya usuli. Qisqa yozuvni qo‘yasiz va gapiruvchi ortidan yarim soniya kechikib takrorlaysiz, faqat so‘zni emas, ritm, urg‘u va ohangni ham. Bu usul aynan biz ko‘rgan to‘rtinchi bo‘shliqni, ya’ni ohangni yopadi. Uning qanday ishlashini keyingi tinglashda podkast boshlovchisidan eshitasiz.
scenes.say: Shadowing means repeating native speech a split second behind the speaker. It trains your mouth to produce the rhythm and melody your ears already recognise.
scenes.say_uz: Soya usuli ona tili egasi nutqini yarim soniya kechikib takrorlashdir. U qulog‘ingiz taniydigan ritm va ohangni og‘zingiz ham chiqara olishini mashq qildiradi.

scenes.title: Immersiya 4: fikr-mulohaza bilan nutq
board: Record → compare with a model → re-record
Speak with tutors, colleagues, online communities
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi usul: chiqish, ya’ni o‘zingiz yozish va gapirish, lekin fikr-mulohaza bilan. Yozganingizni o‘qituvchi yoki tajribali hamkasbga tekshirtiring, keyin qayta yozing. Nutqingizni yozib, namunaga solishtiring va qayta yozing. Fikr-mulohazasiz takror xatoni yanada qotiradi. C2 ga yo‘l ko‘p gapirishdan emas, ko‘p tuzatishdan o‘tadi.
scenes.say: Output alone isn't enough; you need feedback. Write, get corrected, rewrite. Record yourself, compare with a model, and record again. Practice without feedback just makes your mistakes permanent.
scenes.say_uz: Faqat gapirish yetmaydi, fikr-mulohaza kerak. Yozing, tuzattiring, qayta yozing. O‘zingizni yozib oling, namunaga solishtiring va qayta yozing. Mulohazasiz mashq xatolarni doimiy qiladi.

scenes.title: Immersiyadagi xatolar
board: ✗ Chasing rare words, ignoring common chunks
scenes.say_native: Uchta keng tarqalgan xato. Birinchisi, faqat passiv kirish: soatlab tomosha qilish, lekin hech qachon gapirmaslik. Ikkinchisi, doim ona tilidagi subtitr: miya ingliz tilini emas, tarjimani o‘qiydi. Uchinchisi, kamyob, “chiroyli” so‘zlarni quvish va oddiy, tez-tez uchraydigan iboralarni e’tiborsiz qoldirish. C2 egasini “sesquipedalian” so‘zi emas, “it’s not quite what I meant” kabi tabiiy ibora ajratib turadi.
scenes.say: Don't confuse exposure with progress. Hours of passive watching, native-language subtitles and lists of rare words feel productive, but they rarely move you forward.
scenes.say_uz: Muhitni o‘sish bilan adashtirmang. Soatlab passiv tomosha, ona tilidagi subtitr va kamyob so‘zlar ro‘yxati foydali tuyuladi, lekin kamdan kam oldinga siljitadi.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi tinglash: podkast
board: A language podcast: how to shadow
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash til o‘rganish haqidagi podkastdan parcha. Boshlovchi soya usulini qanday to‘g‘ri bajarishni tushuntiradi. Material tanlash, vaqt va o‘zini yozib olish haqidagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering, keyin to‘rtta savol bo‘ladi. Boshlovchi qaysi so‘zlarga urg‘u berayotganini ham kuzating.
scenes.say: Welcome back to the show. Today: shadowing. The idea is simple. You play a short clip of native speech, a sentence or two, and you repeat it a split second behind the speaker, copying not just the words but the rhythm, the stress and the melody. Start with clips you understand completely. Ten minutes a day is plenty, but do it every day. And record yourself once a week, because otherwise you simply won't hear your own progress.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘rsatuvga xush kelibsiz. Bugun: soya usuli. G‘oya oddiy. Ona tili egasi nutqidan bir-ikki gaplik qisqa parchani qo‘yasiz va uni gapiruvchidan yarim soniya keyin takrorlaysiz, faqat so‘zlarni emas, ritm, urg‘u va ohangni ham ko‘chirasiz. To‘liq tushunadigan parchalardan boshlang. Kuniga o‘n daqiqa yetarli, lekin har kuni qiling. Haftada bir marta o‘zingizni yozib oling, aks holda o‘z o‘sishingizni eshitmaysiz.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi tinglash savollari
board: 1) What should you copy besides the words?
2) What kind of clips should you start with?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi: so‘zdan tashqari nimani ko‘chirish kerak. Ikkinchi: qanday parchalardan boshlash kerak. Uchinchi: qancha vaqt va qanchalik tez-tez. To‘rtinchi: nega o‘zingizni yozib olish kerak. Javoblarni qisqa yozing. Raqamlarni aniq yozing. O‘n besh soniya.
scenes.say: Four questions about the podcast. Fifteen seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Podkast haqida to‘rtta savol. O‘n besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: ikkinchi tinglash
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: ritm, urg‘u va ohang. Ikkinchi: to‘liq tushunadigan parchalar, chunki tushunmagan narsani to‘g‘ri takrorlab bo‘lmaydi. Uchinchi: kuniga o‘n daqiqa, lekin har kuni. To‘rtinchi: aks holda o‘z o‘sishingizni eshitmaysiz. E’tibor bering, boshlovchi “plenty” deydi, ya’ni o‘n daqiqa ko‘p emas, lekin yetarli, muhimi muntazamlik.
scenes.say: Rhythm, stress and melody. Clips you understand completely. Ten minutes, every day. And recording lets you hear progress you'd otherwise miss.
scenes.say_uz: Ritm, urg‘u va ohang. To‘liq tushunadigan parchalar. Kuniga o‘n daqiqa, har kuni. Yozib olish esa aks holda sezilmaydigan o‘sishni eshitishga yordam beradi.

scenes.title: Ingliz tilida fikrlash
board: Describe what you're doing: I'd better leave before the traffic builds up.
Explain to yourself why a word fits
scenes.say_native: C2 ga yaqinlashgan sari tarjima qilish vaqti tugashi kerak. Buning uchun ichki monologni ingliz tilida yuriting: yo‘lda ketayotib, ovqat qilayotib nima qilayotganingizni o‘zingizga inglizcha ayting. Biror so‘z topilmasa, belgilab qo‘ying va kechqurun izlang. Bu bepul, istalgan joyda qilinadi va ravonlikni tez oshiradi.
scenes.say: Try running your inner monologue in English. I'd better leave now, before the traffic builds up. When a word is missing, note it and look it up later.
scenes.say_uz: Ichki monologingizni ingliz tilida yuritib ko‘ring. Tirbandlik boshlanmasdan hozir chiqqanim ma’qul. Biror so‘z yetishmasa, belgilab qo‘ying va keyin izlang.

scenes.title: Shaxsiy reja: o‘lchanadigan maqsadlar
board: ✓ 'Read one novel a month and log 10 phrases from each.'
scenes.say_native: Endi shaxsiy rejangiz. “Ingliz tilimni yaxshilash” degan maqsad hech narsa demaydi, uni o‘lchab bo‘lmaydi. Yaxshi maqsad aniq, o‘lchanadigan va muddatli bo‘ladi: “Har oy bitta roman o‘qiyman va har biridan o‘nta ibora yozib olaman”. O‘zingizdagi to‘rt bo‘shliqdan eng kuchsiz ikkitasini tanlang va har biriga bitta shunday maqsad qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Improve my English is a wish, not a goal. A real goal is specific, measurable and time-bound: read one novel a month and log ten phrases from each.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilimni yaxshilash istak, maqsad emas. Haqiqiy maqsad aniq, o‘lchanadigan va muddatli bo‘ladi: har oy bitta roman o‘qish va har biridan o‘nta ibora yozib olish.

scenes.title: Namuna: haftalik jadval
board: 3× a week: podcast in a new accent
Monthly: compare recordings, review phrase log
scenes.say_native: Mana real namuna. Har kuni o‘n daqiqa soya usuli va yigirma daqiqa o‘qish. Haftada uch marta yangi aksentdagi podkast. Haftada bir marta tuzatilgan yozma matn va bitta audio yozuv. Oyda bir marta yozuvlarni solishtirish va iboralar daftarini takrorlash. Jami kuniga taxminan yarim soat, ishlaydigan odam uchun ham real.
scenes.say: Here's a realistic week: ten minutes of shadowing and twenty of reading every day, a podcast in a new accent three times a week, and one corrected text and one recording every week.
scenes.say_uz: Mana real hafta: har kuni o‘n daqiqa soya usuli va yigirma daqiqa o‘qish, haftada uch marta yangi aksentdagi podkast, har hafta bitta tuzatilgan matn va bitta yozuv.

scenes.title: Mashq: uchta maqsadingizni yozing
board: Each: what · how much · by when
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz uchta maqsad yozing, ingliz tilida. Birinchisi bo‘shliqlardan biriga, ikkinchisi immersiyaga, uchinchisi fikr-mulohazaga bag‘ishlansin. Har birida nima, qancha va qachongacha degan uch qism bo‘lsin. Yigirma soniya kamlik qilsa, shu yerda to‘xtatib, bemalol yozing.
scenes.say: Write three goals in English: one for a gap, one for immersion and one for feedback. Each must say what, how much and by when.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilida uchta maqsad yozing: biri bo‘shliq, biri immersiya, biri fikr-mulohaza uchun. Har birida nima, qancha va qachongacha bo‘lsin.

scenes.title: Namuna maqsadlar
board: 1 By March, use 30 new phrasal verbs from my log in speech.
2 Shadow 10 minutes a day for 8 weeks, in two accents.
3 Get one essay corrected every week until June.
scenes.say_native: Namunalarga qarang. Birinchisida bo‘shliq aniq: ibora fe’llar, son bor, muddat bor. Ikkinchisida immersiya: kuniga o‘n daqiqa, sakkiz hafta, ikki aksent. Uchinchisida fikr-mulohaza: har hafta bitta tuzatilgan insho, iyungacha. Maqsadlaringizni shu bilan solishtiring: ularning har birini oy oxirida “bajarildi” yoki “bajarilmadi” deb belgilay olasizmi?
scenes.say: By March, I'll use thirty new phrasal verbs from my log in speech. I'll shadow for ten minutes a day for eight weeks. And I'll get one essay corrected every week until June.
scenes.say_uz: Martgacha daftarimdagi o‘ttizta yangi ibora fe’lni nutqda ishlataman. Sakkiz hafta davomida kuniga o‘n daqiqa soya usulini bajaraman. Iyungacha har hafta bitta inshoni tuzattiraman.

scenes.title: O‘sishni qanday o‘lchaymiz
board: Error log: is the list getting shorter?
Phrase log: how many have you actually used?
scenes.say_native: C2 da o‘sish sekin va ko‘zga ko‘rinmas, shuning uchun uni o‘lchash kerak. Har oy bir xil mavzuda uch daqiqalik nutq yozib oling va oldingisi bilan solishtiring. Xatolar daftaringizdagi ro‘yxat qisqaryaptimi? Iboralar daftaridagi iboralarning nechtasini haqiqatan ishlatdingiz? Bu uch o‘lchov sizga o‘zingizni aldashga yo‘l qo‘ymaydi.
scenes.say: At this level, progress is slow and easy to miss, so measure it. Record the same topic every month, track your error log, and count how many logged phrases you've actually used.
scenes.say_uz: Bu darajada o‘sish sekin va sezilmaydi, shuning uchun uni o‘lchang. Har oy bir mavzuni yozib oling, xatolar daftarini kuzating va yozilgan iboralardan nechtasini ishlatganingizni sanang.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: uch daqiqalik nutq rejasi
board: Topic: My English — where I am and where I'm going
1 Where I am  2 My gaps  3 My plan
Use: one stance adverb, one phrasal verb, one precise word
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Mavzu: “Mening ingliz tilim: hozir qayerdaman va qayerga boraman”. Uch qismli reja tuzing: hozirgi darajangiz, bo‘shliqlaringiz va rejangiz. Bugun o‘rgangan bitta munosabat ravishi, bitta ibora fe’l va bitta aniq so‘zni ishlating. Yigirma soniya rejalang, keyin kirish qismini ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Plan a three-minute talk: my English, where I am and where I'm going. Twenty seconds to plan, then say your opening aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Uch daqiqalik nutqni rejalang: mening ingliz tilim, qayerdaman va qayerga boraman. Yigirma soniya rejalang, keyin kirish qismini ovoz chiqarib ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna kirish
board: Admittedly, … · it turned out that … · plateau
Clear structure: where I am → gaps → plan
scenes.say_native: Namuna kirishni tinglang. Unda “admittedly” munosabat ravishi, “it turned out” ibora fe’li va “plateau” aniq so‘zi bor, oxirida esa nutq rejasi e’lon qilingan. Kirishingizni shu bilan solishtiring: tinglovchi birinchi o‘n besh soniyada nima haqida gapirishingizni biladimi?
scenes.say: Admittedly, I'm quite comfortable in English these days. I can follow a lecture, argue a point and even enjoy a novel. But a year ago it turned out that I'd hit a plateau: I understood nearly everything, yet I still sounded like a textbook. So today I'd like to talk about where I am, what's holding me back, and what I'm doing about it.
scenes.say_uz: Tan olishim kerak, hozir ingliz tilida ancha erkinman. Ma’ruzani tushunaman, fikrimni himoya qilaman, hatto romandan zavq olaman. Lekin bir yil oldin platoga yetganim ma’lum bo‘ldi: deyarli hammasini tushunardim, ammo hali ham darslikdagidek gapirardim. Shuning uchun bugun qayerdaligim, meni nima to‘xtatayotgani va bu borada nima qilayotganim haqida gapirmoqchiman.

scenes.title: Xulosa
board: C2 = effortless precision + nuance (≠ native speaker)
Gaps: articles · phrasal verbs · fossilised errors · prosody
scenes.say_native: Bugungi darsni jamlaylik. C2 bu kuch sarflamasdan aniqlik va nozik ma’nolarni boshqarish, lekin ona tili egasiga aylanish shart emas. Qolgan to‘rt bo‘shliq: artikllar, ibora fe’llar, qotgan xatolar va ohang. To‘rt immersiya usuli: xilma-xil kirish, payqash, soya usuli va fikr-mulohaza. Va bularning hammasini aniq, o‘lchanadigan rejaga aylantirish.
scenes.say: C2 means effortless precision and control of nuance. Find your gaps, immerse yourself deliberately, get feedback, and turn it all into a plan you can measure.
scenes.say_uz: C2 kuch sarflamasdan aniqlik va nuanslarni boshqarish demak. Bo‘shliqlaringizni toping, ongli ravishda til muhitiga sho‘ng‘ing, fikr-mulohaza oling va hammasini o‘lchanadigan rejaga aylantiring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: record a 3-minute talk + list 5 nuances to master
Success: 3 minutes without long pauses; 5 specific nuances with an example each
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: “Mening ingliz tilim: hozir qayerdaman va qayerga boraman” mavzusida uch daqiqalik nutqni yozib oling. Keyin o‘zlashtirmoqchi bo‘lgan beshta nuansni ro‘yxat qiling, masalan “frugal” va “stingy” farqi yoki pasayib-ko‘tariluvchi ohang, har biriga bittadan misol bilan. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: uch daqiqa uzoq pauzasiz va beshta aniq nuans. Keyingi darsda registr, ya’ni rasmiydan so‘zlashuvgacha bo‘lgan uslublarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Record a three-minute talk about your English, then list five nuances you want to master, each with an example. Next time: register, from formal to colloquial.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilingiz haqida uch daqiqalik nutqni yozib oling, so‘ng o‘zlashtirmoqchi bo‘lgan beshta nuansni misoli bilan yozing. Keyingi safar: registr, rasmiydan so‘zlashuvgacha.

homework_uz: “My English: where I am and where I’m going” mavzusida 3 daqiqalik nutqni yozib oling (hozirgi daraja, bo‘shliqlar, reja). So‘ng o‘zlashtirmoqchi bo‘lgan 5 ta nuansni ro‘yxat qiling, har biriga bittadan misol bilan. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: nutq uzoq pauzasiz 3 daqiqa davom etadi va unda kamida bitta munosabat ravishi hamda bitta ibora fe’l bor; ro‘yxatdagi 5 nuansning har biri aniq va misolli.

quiz.q: According to the CEFR, which best describes a C2 user?
options: Speaks with no accent at all
Expresses themselves precisely, differentiating finer shades of meaning
Knows every word in the dictionary
quiz.why_uz: CEFR C2 ni aniq ifoda va ma’noning nozik farqlarini ajratish bilan ta’riflaydi; bu ona tili egasi degani emas.

quiz.q: Choose the most precise word: 'The area is ___ for street crime.'
quiz.why_uz: Yomon narsa bilan mashhur bo‘lish — notorious.

quiz.q: Which word has a NEGATIVE connotation?
quiz.why_uz: Stingy — xasis, salbiy. Frugal va thrifty ijobiy, economical neytral.

quiz.q: '___, the new system saves time.' (The speaker doubts this.)

quiz.why_uz: Umumiy ma’nodagi mavhum ot artiklsiz keladi: Life is beautiful.

quiz.q: 'She ___ Italian while living in Rome.' (learned it naturally)
quiz.why_uz: Pick up a language — tilni o‘z-o‘zidan, muhitda o‘rganib olish.

options: Can you turn on the TV?
Can you make on the TV?
Can you close on the TV?
quiz.why_uz: Televizor turn on qilinadi. Open the TV — o‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z tarjima.

quiz.q: Said with a fall-rise, 'That's an interesting idea…' usually suggests…
quiz.why_uz: Pasayib-ko‘tariluvchi ohang gapni ochiq qoldiradi va yashirin shubha, ya’ni “lekin” ni bildiradi.

quiz.q: Which is the best learning goal?
options: Speak like a native speaker soon.
Shadow for 10 minutes a day for 8 weeks and record myself weekly.
quiz.why_uz: Yaxshi maqsad aniq, o‘lchanadigan va muddatli bo‘ladi.
